articles.title: Rubio Threatens ‘Tremendous Damage’ to ICC Unless Court Bows to US Demands
articles.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned that Washington could inflict “tremendous damage” on the International Criminal Court unless it changes its approach to prosecuting nationals of nonmember states. The warning raises questions about the future of a court that has issued arrest warrants for Russian President Vladimir Putin and senior Russian military officials over alleged war crimes in Ukraine.
